title: Chapter 309 I Can Support Him For A Lifetime
content:
Chapter 309 I Can Support Him For A Lifetime

"Little guys, if I regret it now, I can take you back, but are there anyone willing to quit?"

At this time, Li Changqing looked at Tang Hao and others in front of him and suddenly said this.

There is no doubt that none of these people came forward.

Li Changqing had expected it long ago, and then smiled.

"Then go in. Whether you can come out alive depends on your own ability."

As he said that, Li Changqing poked out his rough right hand, and a terrifying purple flame immediately condensed.

Seeing this scene, Ye Yan, a disciple under Li Changqing, suddenly breathed a little rapid.

The purple flame was almost a killer move for him, but in Li Changqing's hands, he could only pick it up at will.

And at this time, the purple flame had already flew out.

The next moment.

There was a loud bang.

A gap suddenly opened in the ancient battlefield in the distance.

Seeing this, Li Changqing shouted directly: "Go in quickly!"

No longer hesitated, Tang Hao took the lead and rushed in directly, leaving countless afterimages on the scene with his ghostly body movement.

Ye Yan Dongku and other people on the list of monsters followed closely behind.

In a blink of an eye, all the strongest geniuses in the academy have entered.

"Huh~ Hope, everything goes well."

Li Changqing looked at the ancient battlefield in front of him and murmured to himself.

Of course he knew how cruel it was in the ancient battlefield now, but students needed exercise.

Only by experiencing life and death can we go higher.

After all, flowers in greenhouses have limits.

And at this moment, a sudden sound suddenly sounded from the field.

"Everyone, please disturb me, can I get in?"

When everyone present was shocked when they heard the movement behind them.

When is there someone, why don’t they know? !

He quickly turned around and saw a young and handsome man walking slowly towards the place.

What's strange is that they couldn't see the slightest breath of the man in front of them.

"Can I go in?"

The handsome man spoke again, pointing his finger to the direction of the ancient battlefield in the distance.

Everyone finally reacted.

Xiao Mo's face was heavy, and he always felt familiar when he looked at the eyebrows of the young man in the distance.

But he couldn't remember who he looked like.

"I wonder who you are?"

Xiao Mo asked in confusion.

The others present also looked at the man in front of him with confusion.

No doubt no one knows it.

"Haha, he's just an unknown man."

The handsome man is naturally the embodiment of Lu Daosheng.

This time I sneaked into the lower world, naturally I couldn’t reveal my identity.

However, because of his long-term high position, Lu Daosheng didn't realize that he was very high-profile now.

You can tell by looking at the faces of everyone present.

Everyone looked at him with fear.

As for the unknown.

Haha, who believes it?

Lu Daosheng's every move was full of confidence.

This made everyone believe in their hearts that they were definitely a terrifying old monster with hidden strength.

Buzz —

Space trembles.

The next moment, Lord He appeared at the scene.

When everyone saw Lord He, they sighed relieved, but they were shocked.

Sure enough, they had a good guess.

The man in front of him is definitely not an unknown man.

Didn't you see that even Lord He came forward in person?

At this time, Lord He also looked at Lu Daosheng in front of him with a serious expression.

The longer he watched, the more frightened he became.

It's the first time he's seen such a mysterious person for many years.

He couldn't see through Lu Daosheng's slightest, and he didn't even feel a trace of his breath.

When he reaches his level, it is not something that can hide the hidden breath from his eyes.

What does this mean?

The opponent's strength is far above him!

Thinking of this, he was shocked.

The world is really big.

"If you want to enter, just go in, and there is no need to say much."

Lord He looked at Lu Daosheng with a plain expression in the distance, and then he was kind to the Tao.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng naturally would not be polite.

Lu Daosheng nodded slightly and stepped into the ancient battlefield under the shocked gaze of everyone present.

As the space trembles.

Lu Daosheng's figure suddenly disappeared into everyone's eyes.

"Mr. He, what exactly does this exist?"

At this time, Xiao Mo, the leader of the Xiao clan, hurriedly stepped forward and asked.

The other three tribes and Li Changqing on the side also quietly pricked up their ears and listened carefully.

However, Lord He shook his head slightly.

"It's unspeakable."

As soon as these words were spoken, everyone couldn't help but suck in the cold air.

That man was so terrifying.

At this time, Lord He looked at the direction of the ancient battlefield with an extremely solemn expression.

"You should know that if you want to enter the ancient battlefield, it will not cause energy riots in the ancient battlefield, and your cultivation must not exceed the early stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm. This is a regulation and a rule in the ancient battlefield."

Hearing this, everyone around him nodded slightly.

But Li Changqing was surprised and said, "But just now!"

Everyone was stunned and then suddenly looked at the ancient battlefield.

I saw that the ancient battlefield was still the same, and nothing unusual came.

Could it be that the person who just entered has not exceeded the early stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm?

It's impossible.

Lord He shook his head slightly, "The rules are prepared for the weak."

After saying that, Lord He disappeared from the spot again.

Everyone stood there, and the words of Lord He just echoed in their minds.

Rules are prepared for the weak.

The strong, don't pay attention to it.

So, even when they reach their point, are they just weak?

For a moment, everyone present was in a heavy mood.

After practicing for a long time, I have experienced countless hardships and finally stood at the peak of the fairy world.

But now they know that they are still the weak in the eyes of the strong.

This feeling is very uncomfortable.

.........

"Is this an ancient battlefield? There's nothing."

Looking at the dim sky and the bloody earth, Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly.

At this time, a pool of scarlet blood suddenly burst out with dazzling light.

The next moment, a human figure gradually condensed.

I saw that his face was ferocious, his hair was disheveled, and he was holding a blade condensed from blood in his hand.

The aura has reached the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm!

It is hard to imagine that this is just just entering the ancient battlefield.

"Nothing? Hehehehe, I haven't seen such a arrogant person for a long time,"

Before he finished speaking, he was suddenly stunned.

I saw that Lu Daosheng in front of me had disappeared from the spot at some point.

As if he felt something, he suddenly turned around and saw that Lu Daosheng had already left.

when?

Looking at Lu Daosheng's indifferent back, a strong anger burned unconsciously from the bottom of his heart.

This is the first time that people have been so ignored.

"Arrogant!"

As he said that, he was about to rush towards Lu Daosheng.

However, as soon as he finished speaking, he was stunned.

At this moment, he felt an indescribable force begin to erode his will.

At this moment, he panicked.

The endless years have remained until now and finally turned into ashes.

In a moment, his figure and debater disappeared from the ancient battlefield.

He fell in the true sense.

In the distance, Lu Daosheng did not forget the purpose of his trip.

I took a look at it from time to time in the sky, but I couldn't see what Lu Xue was in, so I'd rather feel at ease when I saw it myself.

If Lu Xue really didn't have that ability, he had to give up.

At worst, I can raise my own daughter for the rest of my life.
